android.desc:
ABOUT MOYAAPP

MoyaApp is South Africa’s all-in-one messaging and content platform. It combines powerful communication tools with access to a wide range of digital services — including public websites, information hubs, entertainment, and more — all in one app. Best of all, selected features and websites are available data-free on supported mobile networks (of which; MTN, Cell C, Telkom or Vodacom in South Africa).


MESSAGING & COMMUNICATION:
• Unlimited text messaging and voice notes, even when when you run out of data, MoyaApp will not cut you off from sending text messages as long as long as you keep your mobile data on when you run out of data or airtime (applicable to selected mobile network providers).
• Group chats 
• Voice and video calls (uses data — users are notified before use)
• End-to-end encrypted personal messages
• Offline message delivery - datafree messaging as long as you keep your mobile data on and are on MTN, Cell C, Telkom or Vodacom in South Africa.
• Automatic contact syncing, MoyaApp will ask your permission to access your contact/ address book.

ACCESS TO PUBLIC & THIRD-PARTY WEBSITES:
MoyaApp offers seamless access to publicly available websites — including official government portals — directly within the app.
Government Website Access:
• Visit the official SASSA website: https://www.sassa.gov.za
• Check grant information, application status, and more
• MoyaApp does not submit applications, collect personal data, or provide government services.

Other Public Information:
• Load shedding updates from public data sources
• News, weather, jobs, education, health, and more


DISCOVER CONTENT & SERVICES:
• 300+ content services (some data-free), including news, sport, entertainment, shopping, and education
• Casual games, quizzes, surveys, and rewards from third-party partners
• Marketplaces for tickets, vouchers, classifieds, and digital services


DATA-FREE USAGE IN SOUTH AFRICA:
Selected MoyaApp features and websites are available without airtime or mobile data on supported South African networks (MTN, Vodacom, Telkom, Cell C).
MoyaApp also works internationally — but data-free access is exclusive to South Africa only.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
MoyaApp is a private, independent platform. It is not affiliated with any government entity, including the South African Social Security Agency (SASSA).
All government-related information is accessed via official public websites or third-party sources.

quotes.text:
https://FreeSolitaire.win brings around $500/mo in advertising revenue. It’s a Klondike Solitaire PWA (progressive web application).

I started making it in 2016 and I’ve been slowly iterating on it over time. It has stayed minimal & lightweight, on purpose. No framework, no cruft, no obtrusive ads.

Fun fact: because it’s so lightweight, it was included in 2020 in Moya (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nu.bi.moya), a popular messaging app in South Africa that is “data-free” for users (it does reverse-billing). Now ~40% of players are South Africans!

Discussed on HN from to time, for instance:

— https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42026575 (38 days ago, 19 points)

— https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=41971887 (43 days ago, 25 points) “Quick side-note. Thank you for freesolitaire.win. It's such a beautiful implementation of solitaire. Works so well as a PWA, I can enjoy it even without proper internet connection, it's simple, does the basics, but does it perfectly. There's nothing to add to it, but more importantly... nothing to take out.” (!)

— https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=34483398 (2023, 4 points)

Feedback always welcome, and happy to answer any question!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Those making $500/month on side projects in 2024 – Show and tell
